name: Geo Content
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Create geo targeted content for your website pages. Perfect for personalizing your website by country, state & city.

This plugin can allow you to deliver content from Geo Targetly or use WordPress shortcodes to show/hide your own content.

This plugin is made by Geo Targetly

  • Paid account is required see pricing

  • Get a 14 day free trial on sign up

Features

  • Show content by country, state, city, IP address, latitude-longitude-radius

  • Create multiple pieces of content each targeted at a particular geo location

  • Add default content for non-targeted visitors

  • Restrict content to only certain pages

  • Create content in Geo Targety and inject into your pages

  • Hide/show content based on location using shortcodes

  • Built in analytics

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview

  • Docs

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g1584674684.co to load and run a script that powers its core functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

Additionally, this plugin connects to analytics endpoint https://g97676560.co/ to track plugin installation and usage over time.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
